Subject: Curated attendee triage + SDR handoff plan (webinar: Scaling LLMs at AppScale)

Hey Jordan + Priya —

Thanks again for joining today, really appreciate the thoughtful Q&A. I promised to send a short plan for next steps so your team can pick the three accounts you want us to prioritize for outreach. Attached is the attendee export with a few quick columns we added (role, company size, engagement score).

High-level proposal:
- We’ll mark accounts with engagement score >= 75 as "high-touch" and route to our AE outreach queue for bespoke intro sequences.
- Accounts 50-74 -> SDR personalized cadence (2-touch: email + call).
- <50 -> nurture track with the replay and a short survey.

Action for Acme: please flag up to 3 accounts you want us to prioritize and share any account-specific context (target personas, buying committee names). I’ll route the queue and share the HubSpot pipeline link for transparency.

Attachments: attendee_export_20270719.csv, webinar_replay_link.txt

Karthik Iyer

Subject: Re: Curated attendee triage + SDR handoff plan (webinar: Scaling LLMs at AppScale)

Thanks Karthik — I pulled the attendee export and created a quick MQL mapping workbook (mql_mapping_20270719.xlsx). Notes:
- 42 total unique companies, 128 registrants.
- Engagement score uses: (chat interactions * 0.5) + (questions asked * 3) + (time watched factor).
- Flagged 9 accounts as >=75 (see sheet "high_touch").

Recommended routing (we can adjust per Jordan/Priya input):
- AE queue (high-touch): Ben to own outreach for these — proposed cadence: personalized email, calendar request, 1-call discovery.
- SDR queue: 15 accounts, playbook: 2 emails + 1 CTA to schedule demo (standard template).
- Nurture: everything else — send replay + 1-week follow-up survey.

I attached the workbook and exported CSV. Ben, I added a HubSpot view link in the workbook (tab: ops_links).

Attachments referenced: mql_mapping_20270719.xlsx, attendee_export_20270719.csv

Grace O'Connor
